Dhurandhar Box Office Collection Worldwide Day 32 Update: Ranveer Singh film earns over Rs 1240 crore worldwide.
Dhurandhar Box Office Collection Worldwide Day 32 Update:
Dhurandhar
has completed a month at the box office, and on its 32nd dayits fifth Mondaythe film saw it lowest single-day haul, earning Rs 4.5 crore, as per early estimates. Trade aggregator Sacnilk reported that the film has made Rs 776.75 crore with its India net earning. However, films makers, Jio Studios, claim Dhurandhar domestic collection stands over Rs 820 crore. Despite this dip with its Monday earnings, the Aditya Dhar directorial, with earnings of Rs 1240 crore worldwide, has surpassed the lifetime collections of Pathaan and Jawan, emerging as the second highest-grossing Hindi film of all time, after Aamir Khans Dangal.
Dhurandhar recorded an overall Hindi occupancy of 11.45% on January 5, 2026. On Monday, the film saw 6.84% occupancy in morning shows, which rose to 13.09% in the afternoon and further improved to 14.41% during evening shows.

Dhurandhar has been on a box office rampage, delivering a consistently stellar performance over its first 31 days. While collections may now be slowing marginally, the film appears to be setting the stage for its much-anticipated sequel, which promises to explore the idea of a Naya Bharat, as declared by Ranveer Singhs character Hamza. The makers have already announced that the second part of the film is slated for release on March 19.

Despite the release of Ikkis, Dhurandhar continues to maintain a strong hold at the box office. In contrast, Ikkisdespite receiving largely positive reviewsappears to be struggling commercially. The Agastya Nanda-starrer, now in its fifth day, has earned just Rs 1.02 crore despite running in over 2,000 shows across India. Meanwhile, Dhurandhar continues to enjoy nearly 4,000 shows nationwide, driven by exceptionally strong word-of-mouth.

Live Updates
Jan 6, 2026 09:57 PM IST
Dhurandhar Box Office Update: Dhurandhar to surpass RRR and KGF 2
Globally, Dhurandhar has earned Rs 1214.4 crore so far, as per Sacnilk. The film is set to surpass KGF 2 (Rs 1215 crore) and RRR (Rs 1230 crore) shortly.
Jan 6, 2026 09:05 PM IST
Dhurandhar Box Office Update: Ranveer Singh could surpass RRR on Day 33
After 32 days in cinemas, Dhurandhar earned Rs 777 crore in India. RRR, during its run, earned Rs 782.2 crore in India. Dhurandhar needs to earn over Rs 5.2 crore to surpass that benchmark. After this, Dhurandhar will become the fourth highest domestic grosser of all time after Pushpa 2 (Rs 1234.1 crore), Baahubali 2 (Rs 1030.42 crore) and KGF 2 (Rs 859.7 crore). Dhurandhar is the only film in this list that has been released only in one language. All the aforementioned films had a pan-India release across various languages.
Jan 6, 2026 08:17 PM IST
Dhurandhar Movie Update: Aditya Dhar visits Maa Baglamukhi Mandir
After the success of Dhurandhar, director Aditya Dhar, along with wife Yami Gautam, visited Maa Baglamukhi Mandir in Bankhandi, Himachal Pradesh.
Jan 6, 2026 07:42 PM IST
Dhurandhar Movie Update: 'Ranveer Singh was not offended when I bruised him in the car scene'
Actor Naveen Kaushik, in a chat with Siddharth Kannan, spoke about the climax action sequence in the car and recalled that Ranveer got a few bruises during the scene. "Ranveer got a few bruises when we were shooting the climax car action sequence but he never took offence. He told us that you do it well, and he also taught me how to do such action sequences so there is tension in the arm but the hamd stays free so it looks like you are putting in all your strength but the other actor doesn't get injured. I could see that he was in a bit of pain but he was also teaching me at the same time. He never got offended, he shared.
Jan 6, 2026 07:16 PM IST
Dhurandhar Movie Update: 'Unfair' for Ranveer Singh
Naveen Kaushik, in a chat with Siddharth Kannan, said that Ranveer not getting enough credit for his role was "unfair". "I do feel its unfair. Akshaye sir has undoubtedly created an iconic character that will be remembered for years. But what Ranveer has done as an actor: the tiny nuances, his voice modulation, for someone who is so energetic in real life to suppress all of that and play the complete opposite, its extremely difficult," he said.
Jan 6, 2026 06:34 PM IST
Dhurandhar Movie Update: 'Shararat' was inspired by 'Dola Re'?
In a recent interview with Pinkvilla, choreographer Vijay Ganguly shared that he sought inspiration from Saroj Khan's choreography in Devdas' Dola Re for Dhurandhar's Shararat. Vijay shared that he often watches Dola Re before starting a new song but in this case, it meant more as here too, the song was going to be filmed on two dancers.
Jan 6, 2026 06:03 PM IST
Dhurandhar Box Office Collection Day 32 Update: Ranveer Singh film breaks records across North America, Australia, UK
Trade analyst Sumit Kadel reported, "Overseas, Dhurandhar has turned into a global juggernaut, clocking Rs 272 CR gross (US$30.5M) in just four weeks - surpassing the lifetime overseas (ex-China) business of Dangal, Padmaavat, Bajrangi Bhaijaan and Dhoom 3, without a Gulf release. With all-time records across North America, Canada, Australia and strong positioning in the UK, Aditya Dhars directorial for Jio Studios & B62 Studios is no longer just breaking records -it is redefining the global ceiling of Indian cinema."
Jan 6, 2026 05:41 PM IST
Dhurandhar Box Office Collection Day 32 Update: The economics of Ranveer Singh film
What makes the deal even sweeter for Dhurandhar, which has already earned Rs 600 crore profit from its box office collection -- is the fact that both the parts of the film were shot together within the Rs 225-250 crore budget. This means Dhurandhar 2's earning will just top up what is already a record-breaking profit.
Jan 6, 2026 05:26 PM IST
Dhurandhar Box Office Collection Day 32 Update: Film earns Rs 600 cr profit
The Ranveer Singh film has reportedly earned a profit of around Rs 600 crore, as per Koimoi. Made at an estimated budget of Rs 225-250 crore, it has done box office collection of Rs 825.70 crores in 32 days. As it continues to play in theatres, the film has already made a whopping Rs 600 crore profit.

Dhurandhar Box Office Collection Day 32 Update: Ranveer Singh film earns Rs 1247 cr
Dhurandhar collected Rs 1247.1 cr at the worldwide box office while it collected Rs 825.70 cr in India.

Dhurandhar Box Office Collection Day 32 Update: Ranveer Singh film sees 25% uptick
As the makers of Dhurandhar introduced a blockbuster Tuesday offer, allowing people to watch the film for Rs 199, it again saw an uptick in bookings. The film has sold 1.22 lakh tickets through advance booking for Tuesday, a massive jump as compared to 98.2K tickets that were sold on fifth Monday.

Dhurandhar Box Office Collection Day 32 Update: Ranveer Singh film earns Rs 5.4 cr on fifth Monday, say makers
As per Dhurandhar producers Jio Studios, the film has made Rs 5.4 crore on its fifth Monday, taking its total domestic box office collections to Rs 825.7 crores.
Jan 6, 2026 12:03 PM IST
Dhurandhar Box Office Collection Day 32 Update: Dhurandhar makers slash ticket prices to push sales
As Dhurandhar starts slowing down, the makers have come up with an offer to encourage a second viewing of the film. "Jio Studios and B62 Studios unleash a dhamakedaar offer... Catch Dhurandhar on the big screen, with tickets starting at just Rs 199," the update said..

Dhurandhar Box Office Collection Day 32 Update: Ranveer Singh film earns Rs 825.7 cr
"Dhurandhar box office collection for Week 5 stands at: Fri 9.70 cr, Sat 12.60 cr, Sun 13.50 cr, Mon 5.40 cr. Total:  825.70 cr. India biz," reported Taran Adarsh.

Dhurandhar Box Office Collection Day 32 Update: Ranveer Singh film closes in on Pushpa 2 record
Trade analyst Taran Adarsh posted Dhurandhar's box office performance on fifth Monday, "Dhurandhar closes in on the lifetime business of Pushpa 2 #hindi as it steps into the weekdays. The long holiday period, from #christmas to #newyear, has ended and, expectedly, the overall business is likely to slow down on weekdays, especially. The film faces fresh competition from The Raja Saab, starring Prabhas, this Friday [9 Jan 2026]... It will be interesting to see how strongly #dhurandhar holds its ground over the weekend."

Dhurandhar may be slowing down but there are still records that it will scale before wrapping up. Within this week, the Ranveer Singh starrer will storm past SS Rajamouli's RRR (Rs 1230 crore) as it has already earned Rs 1215 crore.

Dhurandhar Box Office Collection Day 32 Update: 'Shararat left me anxious'
Even as Dhurandhar;s Shararat rules the charts, its choreographer has opened up on how the song left him anxious with a particular portion of the number featuring Krystle DSouza and Ayesha Khan taking an extensive amount of time tand effort.

Dhurandhar Box Office Collection Day 32 Update: Ranveer Singh film sees 11.64% occupancy
Dhurandhar's occupancy remained high even after a month at the ticket windows. It saw an overall 11.64% Hindi occupancy on Monday, with morning shows witnessing 6.84% occupancy. It showed an uptick during the day with afternoon shows clocking 13.09%, evening shows seeing 14.41% and night shows registering 12.23% occupancy.

Dhurandhar Box Office Collection Day 32 Update: Tickets sold for Dhurandhar on fourth Tuesday
In multiplex, close to 100K tickets have been sold for Dhurandhar -- PVR Inox and Cinepolis have sold 43,186 tickets while Cinepolis has witnessed a sale of 6,780 tickets.

Dhurandhar Box Office Collection Day 32 Update: Ranveer Singh film sells almost 100K tickets
Dhurandhar might be slowing down but it is still packing a lot of punch. As per Koimoi, the Ranveer Singh-starrer has sold almost 100,000 tickets for its fifth Tuesday and has 8,694 shows still playing.

Dhurandhar Box Office Collection Day 32 Update: Kartik Aaryan starrer earns Rs 30 lakh
Dhurandhar outdid both Tu Meri Main Tera Main Tera Tu Meri at the box office despite registering a 65% drop in its earnings. The Kartik Aaryan-Ananya Panday film earned Rs 30 lakh on its day 12, bringing its total box office earning to Rs 32.3 crores.
Jan 6, 2026 07:21 AM IST
Dhurandhar Box Office Collection Day 32 Update: Dhurandhar outperforms Ikkis and Tu Meri Main Tera
Despite seeing a massive drop, Dhurandhar continues to outperform the new releases, including Ikkis that came out this week. On the Day 5 of its release which was also the first Monday, the Agastya Nanda-starrer earned Rs 1.35 crore. In comparison, Dhurandhar made Rs 4.5 crore on its fifth Monday.
Jan 6, 2026 07:16 AM IST
Dhurandhar Box Office Collection Day 32 Update: Ranveer Singh film registers its biggest dip
After making records for earning in two figures during most of its box office stay, Dhurandhar finally dropped into single figures on its fifth Monday after registering a 65% drop. The Ranveer Singh starrer earned an estimated Rs 4.5 crore on day 32, making it the film's lowest earning day. However, the film has completed over a month on the ticket windows and this comes as no surprise.
